detail: Repaint this enchanted fae armor, sword and shield atlas using richly leaf-etched jade and teal enamel panels, warm ivory sections and coral pink accents. Preserve exact circular shield discs, center gems, sword blades, armor plates and joints. Contrasting central gems with teal/pink faceted depth remain the exact original positions and sizes. Add delicate antique gold floral filigree, ivory silver and rose metal inlay, tiny leaf veins, scratched enamel, soft green patina at existing seams, fine floral patterns constrained to existing panels. The two large circular discs near top center have ornate enamel and gold floral detailing within the unchanged circular layout. Distinct materials, bright ivory and jade and warm rose, no uniform metallic hue.
